feature: Small items 2, item 6a: one filtered-empty state (the shared ZeroState) on /collection and both /commanders lanes
note: Board: design/design_handoff_the99_small_items_2/Filtered-Empty.dc.html. Collection keeps its own words (heading naming the query and colors, its caption); with a query it leads with Keep only search then Clear all filters, filters only shows Clear all filters alone. The owned and discover lanes on /commanders draw the same shape with their own copy. Filters are set through the URL so no row depends on what a press opens.

shares.note: The one filtered-empty shape. Each row's view is the file that renders ZeroState for that surface.

rows.label: /collection?q=zzqx&c=RG: heading names the query and Gruul, caption, Keep only search (primary) then Clear all filters
/collection?c=WUBRG&m=exact&s=zzz filtered to nothing with no query: the colors heading, caption, Clear all filters alone
/commanders?p=zzz, the owned lane at zero: the same diamonds, heading, body and buttons in its own words
/commanders/discover?p=zzz, the discover lane at zero: the same shape
